title: Chapter 184: Glorious Victory
content:
Chapter 184: Glorious Victory

The Zerg now has only ten three-star Exploding Swarms left in the sky above the battlefield. Wu Qing has been looking for valuable targets to test the power of three-star Exploding Swarms.

Now there is such a powerful team of demons, which is the right target.

In the game setting, Exploding Swarms are a high-lethal force that can blow up interstellar human battleships and interstellar Protoss motherships with just a few of them, which shows how powerful their explosive power is.

Judging from the performance on the battlefield, the power of Exploding Swarms without stars is already very powerful, and can deal with very strong targets by surprise.

Even if the enemy is prepared, as long as there are enough Exploding Swarms, it can produce good results.

The current target is two at least four-star strongmen, and there are hundreds of two-star strongmen. They have all seen the attack methods of Exploding Swarms and are prepared for self-destruction attacks from the air.

The difficulty of the attack has increased, but the three-star Exploding Swarms are carrying out the mission. The star level has been raised by three levels, and the ability is no longer comparable.

"Even if they are prepared, they may not be able to defend themselves!"

Wu Qing saw that the team of demon clan warriors had already stood still, so he ordered the ten three-star explosive mosquitoes in the air to attack immediately.

The three-star explosive mosquitoes are more than three times the size of ordinary explosive mosquitoes, but they are faster and more flexible.

Ten three-star explosive mosquitoes dived down, and their normal diving speed exceeded the acceleration state of ordinary explosive mosquitoes, which greatly exceeded the expectations of the demon clan warriors below.

They had witnessed the attack of explosive mosquitoes with their own eyes and were prepared to deal with this kind of dive attack from the air, but these ten special explosive mosquitoes were too fast, so fast that they could not react.

The strongest flame demon fired a fireball at will, flying towards the diving explosive mosquitoes, and the other flame demons beside it also hurriedly fired a fireball that was obviously not well prepared and flew into the air.

Hundreds of fire demons fired fireballs that soared into the sky, but the speed of the three-star explosive mosquitoes was too fast. Those fire demons with insufficient strength could not see the trajectory of the explosive mosquitoes' dive at all, and could only detonate the fireballs directly by feeling.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The fireballs in the air exploded into pieces. If they were ordinary flying soldiers, they would definitely suffer heavy losses in the face of such an indiscriminate large-scale attack.

Unfortunately, their enemies were ten three-star explosive mosquitoes of the Zerg, a terrifying soldier that even Wu Qing had never seen its true strength.

Wu Qing also saw the movements of the three-star explosive mosquitoes clearly through host No. 3. They suddenly turned on the accelerated sprint state, and their speed was more than twice as fast, so fast that ordinary people could not even see their shadows.

Even in this high-speed state, they can still effectively control the direction and flexibly pass through the explosion interception of the fireballs. The aftermath of the fireball explosion has no effect on them at all!

Originally, the flying speed of the three-star Zerg Explosive Swarm was not very high. From their attack to now, it was only a matter of a moment. Once their acceleration was turned on, they dived to the target in an instant, almost like teleporting!

Only the strongest flame demon had time to add a fireball, which exploded above their heads, affecting the trajectory of two three-star explosive mosquitoes. The other eight three-star explosive mosquitoes dived to the predetermined position.

"Boom...!"

The explosion was too violent, and people could no longer tell how many explosions were superimposed on each other. The strong energy shock wave swept everything around, and the terrible Zerg biological decomposition liquid almost splashed to the position of the Naga army!

Many parts of the Demon Clan Castle, which was closer, collapsed in the explosion. Many people in the Naga army felt uncomfortable. Except for the Zerg puppies, the other armies of both sides who were fighting had a brief pause!

At the center of the explosion, it was almost blown into a white area. The strongest fire demon used a fire defense magic on himself at the last moment. The fiery red light only lasted for a moment in the explosion, and then dissipated quietly, and the fire demon inside also disappeared with the light.

All the demon army near the center of the explosion disappeared, and at a farther distance, there were fallen demon wounded everywhere.

The power of ten three-star explosive mosquitoes was amazing. They exploded at the same time, producing a very terrible killing effect. With just this one explosion, all the strong men in the demon army were wiped out, and a large number of demon troops were also affected.

This power exceeded Wu Qing's expectations, and it also greatly exceeded Naga's expectations!

"No. 3, this doesn't look like an attack launched by a single army at all!"

Naga exclaimed.

"This is our tribe's high-star self-destructing army. It consumed a lot of resources to cultivate it. This explosion destroyed it. It is very rare!"

Wu Qing did not forget to emphasize the preciousness of the three-star explosive mosquitoes. These three-star explosive mosquitoes were indeed temporarily upgraded by him consuming a lot of Qi resources. If he had not seen the Qiyun beads generously given by the Naga tribe, he would not have been willing to do so.

"Thank you for the sacrifice of the nobles!"

Naga was very clear about the impact of this explosion. A sincere thank you could not represent her heart. There would definitely be more benefits for the Zerg in the future.

This is the effect that Wu Qing wanted. He grabbed the resources on the battlefield, and after the war, the allies also sent a lot of thank-you gifts.

In addition, the outstanding performance of the Zerg on the battlefield won the friendship of all the Naga troops. If this reputation spread, it would be a sustainable source of Qi resources.

Loyalty, courage, powerful, decisive, and other labels can all be attached to the Zerg, which is a huge asset for the Zerg!

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

"Use all the ammunition of all siege weapons!"

Naga did not say more to Wu Qing, and seized the opportunity to command the Naga army to fight.

The siege weapons of the Naga army and the precious ammunition made by the remaining goblins were all used up at once and hit the demon army, destroying a large number of the demon army's living forces.

The demon army suddenly encountered this major change, and their mysterious combat command mechanism played a role. The remaining demon army was effectively organized and continued to fight against the Naga army and Zerg dogs who launched a full-scale attack.

But the gap in the strength of the two warring parties is too great. The demon army has suffered a series of blows. Although its morale has not collapsed, it has already declined and is unable to turn the tide.

The Naga warriors put away their bows and arrows, picked up their shields and long swords, and launched a siege against the demon army.

The Zerg puppies fought more frantically. In order to grab more resources, they rushed to places where there were many demon troops, fought hard and bitter battles, and moved the troops of various tribes in the Naga army. Their fighting became more courageous.

The Zerg puppies, who focused on grabbing resources, actually improved the morale and combat effectiveness of their allies, which was also an unexpected gain.

Supported by the dignity of the demons, the last demon army was surrounded and killed by the Zerg puppies at the foot of the wall of the demon castle. They did not let the enemy enter the demon castle before they died in battle.

The Naga army could actually attack the castle directly, but they did not do so. The enemy was willing to fight to the death outside the castle, so there was no need to deliberately trample on the enemy's dignity.

Wu Qing also agreed with this approach, allowing the Zerg puppies to concentrate on killing the enemy and not enter the demon castle in advance.

All the demon army outside the castle died in battle, and the Naga army rushed into the castle and completely occupied the demon castle that had been standing.

The war that the Naga and Zerg joined forces to actively launch to attack the demon castle was officially over!

The Naga tribe won an unprecedented glorious victory in this area!

The Zerg played a very critical role in this glorious victory.

All the Naga troops were full of respect when they saw the tens of thousands of Zerg puppies left on the battlefield.

"No. 3, you go back to the city to rest! The rest will be left to us!"

Naga did not say much, just let the Zerg army go back to the Naga city to rest.

"Okay!"

Wu Qing agreed very straightforwardly.

The war here ended, it was already late, and the war in the underground world was about to end.

...

The Zerg learned some of the situation in the underground world at night through the reconnaissance parasites released by the queen. There was no weird appearance in the underground world at night, and it was no different from the daytime.

But Wu Qing didn't dare to let the Zerg fight in the underground world at night. Outside the underground world, weird things were rampant, which was equivalent to cutting off the Zerg's retreat. If they encountered an emergency, they would have nowhere to retreat.

The Zerg army fighting in the underground world was all Wu Qing's accumulated assets, and they couldn't take risks in the mysterious underground world.

If things went wrong, the ghouls would do something in the next moment, and if the Zerg couldn't cope with it, they would suffer heavy losses.

So when it was evening in the outside world, the Zerg army fighting in the underground world would start to evacuate.

In the underground battlefield, the Zerg took out two powerful weapons, cockroaches and destroyers, and the ghouls were completely helpless. They had only one choice: to rush and force the ghouls.

Countless ghouls were transformed into system resources under the joint attack of Zerg puppies, cockroaches, stealth spiders, hydralisks and destroyers, and the Zerg lost only a small number of puppies.

The Zerg cockroaches have strong defense, strong vitality, and fast recovery speed. They are simply impossible to kill. If they are in danger, the Zerg puppies next to them and the stealth spiders underground will do their best to protect them.

Wu Qing's principle is that if the troops that consume gas resources can be spared, they will not be lost. If there must be losses, then the Zerg puppies will be lost. If it is really unavoidable, they will be ranked according to the amount of gas resources consumed, and the troops that consume less gas resources will be lost first.

As the sky outside gradually darkened, the Zerg army began to withdraw reluctantly.

The battle line continued to shrink backwards. When it shrank to a certain extent, the huge stealth spiders that drilled into the ground withdrew from the underground world first.

1,000 destroyers launched a round of fierce attacks on the ghouls, and the second batch withdrew.

Zerg puppies, cockroaches, and hydralisks continued to retreat, shrinking the defense line, and the Zerg dragons withdrew from the air.

The destroyers and stealth spiders that withdrew from the underground world suppressed the ghouls on the platform, and other Zerg troops retreated in an orderly manner and all left the underground world.
